definitions.explanation: Lacking emotion or showing no emotional response. Describes a person, expression, or manner that appears cold or indifferent.

examples.japanese: {無感情|むかんじょう}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak in an emotionless voice.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{無感情|むかんじょう}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That person always has an emotionless expression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{無感情|むかんじょう}で⟦いられる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧だろう。
examples.english: Few people can remain emotionless even after hearing sad news.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) and ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧ (emotion, feeling). Used to describe people, voices, expressions, or attitudes that show no emotional affect.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無感情|むかんじょう}な⟦{表情|ひょうじょう}→表情：03585_hyoujou⟧: emotionless expression
- {無感情|むかんじょう}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: flat, emotionless voice
- {無感情|むかんじょう}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: apathetic attitude
- {無感情|むかんじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧: to appear emotionless

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無表情|むひょうじょう}→無表情：23140_muhyoujou⟧: expressionless — focuses on the face showing no expression, while {無感情|むかんじょう} describes the inner state of having no emotion
- ⟦{冷淡|れいたん}→冷淡：16166_reitan⟧: cold, indifferent — implies active coldness toward others, not just absence of emotion
- ⟦{淡々|たんたん}→淡々：05897_tantan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: matter-of-factly — describes a calm, detached manner without the negative connotation of emotional emptiness
